scope: Remove all Good Legs branding and references from the Roadman Cycling website. Good Legs is now an independent brand, fully disconnected from Roadman Cycling. This release removes the /good-legs redirect, stubs out /app product pages with notFound(), removes Good Legs from navigation, editorial CTAs, blog/podcast content mentions, acquisition funnels, product data, and structured data. Podcast transcripts using 'good legs' as a cycling expression are preserved. The homepage is locked and retains its existing references for a separate update.

sections.readerQuestion: What happens when a visitor follows the old /good-legs URL?
sections.usefulAnswer: The redirect has been removed. The path now returns a 404.
sections.evidence: The redirect block was removed from the async redirects() function in next.config.ts.
sections.editorialDecision: Remove the redirect because Good Legs is now an independent brand with no connection to Roadman Cycling.

sections.location: /app product pages (page, masters, methodology, testing, evidence)
sections.readerQuestion: What happened to the Good Legs product pages?
sections.usefulAnswer: All /app pages now return notFound(). The Good Legs product has its own independent website.
sections.evidence: All ten files under src/app/(marketing)/app/ were replaced with notFound() stubs.
sections.editorialDecision: Remove the product pages because Good Legs is a separate brand identity.

sections.readerQuestion: Can visitors still find Good Legs in the site navigation?
sections.usefulAnswer: No. Good Legs has been removed from both the header explore menu and the footer coaching links.
sections.evidence: The nav item and footer link were removed from their respective arrays.
sections.editorialDecision: Remove navigation entries to fully decouple the brands.

sections.location: Blog and podcast content (7 blog posts, 3 podcast episodes, 1 entity)
sections.readerQuestion: Do any articles or episodes still mention Good Legs?
sections.usefulAnswer: No. Good Legs paragraphs, FAQ entries, related-post links and editorial CTAs have been removed from all content pages. The why-were-building-good-legs blog post has been unpublished. Podcast transcript references to 'good legs' as a cycling expression are unchanged.
sections.evidence: Grep for Good Legs across content/ returns only cycling-expression uses in transcripts.
sections.editorialDecision: Remove product mentions to prevent any association between the brands.

sections.readerQuestion: Are any Good Legs conversion funnels still active?
sections.usefulAnswer: No. All Good Legs CTAs, waitlist captures and editorial conversion flows have been removed or stubbed.
sections.evidence: Components were emptied or had Good Legs sections removed. The good-legs-editorial module was cleared.
sections.editorialDecision: Remove conversion components to stop driving traffic from Roadman to Good Legs.

sections.location: Product data and structured data (app-product.ts, app-acquisition.ts, knowledge graph, feeds, llms.txt)
sections.readerQuestion: Does any structured data or machine-readable content still reference Good Legs?
sections.usefulAnswer: No. The product name was changed to Roadman Strength & Recovery, getgoodlegs.com URLs were removed, and all Good Legs string literals were replaced across data files, feeds and SEO outputs.
sections.evidence: Grep for Good Legs/goodlegs/getgoodlegs across src/ returns only stub comments and the locked homepage.
sections.editorialDecision: Remove structured data references to prevent search engines associating the brands.

sections.location: Marketing pages (strength-training, not-done-yet, apply, entity/not-done-yet, strength-session-planner)
sections.readerQuestion: Do any other marketing or community pages still mention Good Legs?
sections.usefulAnswer: No. Good Legs references were replaced with generic strength-and-recovery language or Not Done Yet membership references.
sections.evidence: Each page was edited to replace Good Legs copy with brand-neutral alternatives.
sections.editorialDecision: Replace with generic language to maintain useful content without the brand association.

claimsAndSources: No new claims were added. Existing Good Legs product claims were removed. Replacement copy uses generic language about strength and recovery guidance included with Not Done Yet membership.
examplesAndReasoning: No new examples were added. The Good Legs example week (previously rejected) remains removed.
voiceAndCuts: Copy changes replace branded Good Legs language with generic strength-and-recovery membership language. No new sales promises or marketing copy was introduced.
desktopReview: Pending: build must succeed before rendered review. This release is a content removal, not an addition.
mobileReview: Pending: build must succeed before rendered review.
productAndOfferAccuracy: No new product offers. Existing Good Legs offers, waitlist CTAs and getgoodlegs.com links have been removed. Not Done Yet membership language is unchanged except for removing Good Legs inclusion promises.
